targets.query: from(bucket:"stream_metrics") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "playback" and r.event == "stall" and r._field == "stallDurationMs") |> count()
from(bucket:"stream_metrics") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "playback" and r._field == "stallDurationMs") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Top user agents by stall count (24h)

targets.query: from(bucket:"stream_metrics") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "playback" and r.event == "stall") |> group(columns: ["ua"]) |> count() |> sort(columns:["_value"], desc:true) |> limit(n:20)
